title: evaluator's in
description: What the main conversation gives an evaluator as it starts: its Cut, which holds only what the deliverable's people have. tree.py's code gives it, through the adapter of a start's text, and the guard limits the evaluator's calls to its run values.

start.description: The Cut, one JSON object on the first line of the prompt that starts the evaluator.

record.description: The path of the start's record, a file in the run's records/ that the role writes only by record.py, in the form of record.schema.json, and that rn's check reads at the role's end.

deliverable.description: The path of the deliverable it judges.

name.description: The deliverable's name in the design tree: the one thing that holds toward the goal once it exists, which names its people and what they achieve with it.

best_practice.description: The folder of the best practice whose group of necessary conditions it judges by, of the deliverable's kind or the refactor one.

conditions.description: The ID of each necessary condition of its group.

answers.description: The path of the file in the round where it writes its Answers.

step.description: The step it stood at, where a paused run picks up, from the start's Place. Absent at a start anew.
